parts.label: a
parts.description: Find t when v = e^(sin t) + 4 sin t = 0 on [0, 6]
parts.notes: M1 for recognising at rest v = 0. A1 for t = 3.35 seconds. Award M1A0 for additional solutions outside [0,6], e.g. t = -0.205 or t = 6.08.

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find acceleration when particle changes direction
parts.notes: M1 for recognising direction change at v = 0 (or t = 3.347). A2 for a = -4.71 m/s^2 (GDC differentiation of v at t = 3.347).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find total distance travelled by particle on [0, 6]
parts.notes: A1 for setting up integral split at t = 3.347 (since v changes sign). A1 for total distance = 14.310 + 6.443 = 20.8 m.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Find period of H(t) = a cos(7.8t) + b

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find a and b given min = 1, max = 1.8
parts.tolerance: Accept |a| = 0.4 with sign justified by H(0) = min = 1.
parts.notes: M1 for amplitude = (max - min)/2 OR for system of two equations using H(0) = 1 and H(pi/7.8) = 1.8. A1 for a = -0.4. A1 for b = 1.4.

parts.label: c
parts.description: Number of times weight reaches maximum in first 5 seconds
parts.notes: A1 for 5/period = 6.207 OR enumeration of t = 0.403, 1.21, 2.01, 2.82, 3.62, 4.43. A1 for 6 times.

parts.label: d
parts.description: First time the base reaches H = 1.5 m
parts.notes: M1 for setting H(t) = 1.5 and solving on [0, 10]. A1 for t = 0.234.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Probability H > 1.5 m at random time in first 5 seconds
parts.notes: M1 for finding second time H = 1.5 (t = 0.572). A1 for noting H > 1.5 for 0.338 s per period (or total 2.028 s in 5 seconds). M1 for multiplying by 6 / dividing by 5. A1 for P = 0.406.

parts.label: a
parts.tolerance: Show that (answer given). Must derive from period = 12.
parts.notes: A1 for 12 = 2*pi/b leading to b = pi/6 (AG).

parts.label: d
parts.description: Smallest possible value of c, given first high tide at t = 4.5
parts.notes: A1 for substituting t = 4.5, H = 6.8 (or recognising quarter-period = 3). M1 for solving sin(pi/6 * (4.5 - c)) = 1, i.e., 4.5 - c = 3. A1 for c = 1.5.

parts.label: e
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t = 12 (graphically or algebraically). A1 for H = 2.87 m.

parts.label: f
parts.description: Hours per 24-hour period when tide > 5 m
parts.notes: M1 for solving H(t) = 5. A1 for crossing times t = 1.919 and 7.082 (with 13.919 and 19.082 in second period). A1 for total = 2(7.082 - 1.919) = 10.3 hours.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Height of point C above ground

parts.label: b
parts.description: Angle of elevation of C from B
parts.notes: A1 for tan(angle B) = 8.21/5. A1 for angle B = 1.02 rad (or 58.7 deg).

parts.label: d
parts.description: Find p and q in h(t) = p cos(3pi/10 * t) + q (max at t=0)
parts.notes: M1 for blade length = amplitude (or system of two equations). A1 for p = 3.91. M1 for centre of windmill = vertical shift. A1 for q = 8.21.

parts.label: e
parts.description: Number n of times D passes overhead in 1 minute
parts.notes: M1 for period = 2pi/(3pi/10) = 20/3 ~ 6.667 s. M1 for rotations per minute = 60/period. A1 for n = 9 (must be integer).
